{{Infobox Slayer |name = Vampyres |icon = [[File:Vyre icon.png|center]] |skillreq = None |combatreq = {{SCP|Combat|35}} |otherreq = Completion of [[Priest in Peril]] |mazchna = 10-20 (200-250) |vannaka = 10-20 (200-250) |chaeldar = 80-100 (200-250) |konar = 100-160 (200-250) |nieve = 110-170 (200-250) |duradel = 100-210 (200-250) |id = 24702 }} [[Vampyres]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] by various [[Slayer master]]s once the player has completed [[Priest in Peril]] and achieved at least level 35 combat. Mostly confined to the [[Morytania]] region, access to different variants of vampyres is usually tied to progression within [[The Myreque|the Myreque questline]]. Prior to the ''[[Actual Vampyre Slayer]]'' unlock, vampyre tasks can only be assigned by Slayer masters [[Mazchna]] and [[Vannaka]] and only 10 to 20 will be assigned at a time. Vampyres come in three different [[Vampyre (attribute)|attribute tiers]] which determines their weaknesses to various [[vampyrebane weapons]]: *Tier 1 vampyres, such as feral vampyres and [[Vampyre Juvenile]]s, can be hurt with any weapon. *Tier 2 vampyres, such as [[Vampyre Juvinate]]s, must be harmed with silver weapons at minimum. Alternatively, wearing [[efaritay's aid]] will allow any weapon to hurt them, but their damage is reduced by 50%. *Tier 3 vampyres, such as [[vyrewatch]], [[Vyrewatch Sentinel]]s and [[venator]]s, require the [[Ivandis flail]] as a minimum. Other superior weapons, such as blisterwood, the [[hallowed flail]] and [[sunspear]] will also work. Efaritay's aid '''does not''' allow normal weapons to damage them. High-levelled players should not toggle vyre tasks on until they have completed [[Sins of the Father]], where they may kill vyrewatch sentinels for their lucrative [[blood shard]] drop. Sentinels are permanently aggressive unless the player has worn a full set of [[vyre noble clothing]], meaning they can be easily AFK'ed with little input by the player as they only use melee. After the third fight against [[Lowerniel Drakan]] in [[The Blood Moon Rises]], all vyres will become tolerant of the player. In order to toggle the sentinels' aggression back, they player must complete the quest and speak to the werewolf hired by [[Lord Mischa Myrmel]] (south of the [[Darkmeyer]] teleport on [[Drakan's medallion]]) to buy a [[garlic cocktail]] from him for 20 coins. Additionally, completion of the quest will unlock [[venator]]s. They are harder than sentinels but have a [[Blood-starved venator|superior]] along with a vastly improved drop rate on the blood shard. [[Efaritay's aid]] is recommended for players who are willing to put some extra cost/time in, as the bonuses of the ring will stack alongside task bonuses. These will generally provide superior damage over other rings such as the [[ultor ring]]. ==Slayer Unlocks== {{Main|Slayer reward point}} {|class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-left-2
